description: Execute multiple spreadsheet operations in a single request. Use for advanced operations like formatting, merging cells, creating filters, conditional formatting, sorting, etc.

includeSpreadsheetInResponse.description: Whether to include the updated spreadsheet in the response

requests.description: Array of Sheets API request objects. See https://developers.google.com/sheets/api/reference/rest/v4/spreadsheets/request for available request types. Common requests include: updateCells, repeatCell, autoFill, cutPaste, copyPaste, mergeCells, unmergeCells, updateBorders, addFilterView, addConditionalFormatRule, sortRange, etc.
